description: This file contains type definitions and data structure classes for the LangGraph API, including request and response type definitions using TypedDict. It is used to define the data formats for input and output in the LangGraph system, supporting streaming and non-streaming communication.

classes.name: LangGraphMessage
classes.description: TypedDict representing a message in the LangGraph API with role and content.

classes.name: LangGraphInput
classes.description: TypedDict representing the input structure for a LangGraph request, containing a list of messages.

classes.name: LangGraphRequest
classes.description: TypedDict defining the request structure for the LangGraph API, including assistant ID, input, stream mode, config, and metadata.

classes.name: LangGraphStreamEvent
classes.description: TypedDict representing a single event in a streaming response, with event type and data.

classes.name: LangGraphResponseMessage
classes.description: TypedDict for a message in a non-streaming LangGraph response, including type, content, and optional ID and name.

classes.name: LangGraphResponse
classes.description: TypedDict for the non-streaming response from LangGraph, including messages and additional values.

classes.name: LangGraphParsedResponse
classes.description: TypedDict for internal parsed response, containing content, role, and optional usage information.
